correctness.rationale: Mémoli–Zhou Theorem 11 identifies equality of complete verbose barcodes with filtered-chain isomorphism. Such an isomorphism preserves filtration ranks in degree one, hence the multiset of all pairwise distances. For any ultrametric of at most four points, the distance multiset determines the isometry class: one distance equilateral; two distances have 3+1,2+2,2+1+1 clustering with distinct multiplicities 3,2,1; three distances have precisely the 1,1,4 or 1,2,3 merge patterns. Independently enumerating all 3^6 labeled 4-point edge assignments found exactly 60 ultrametrics and 14 distance-multiset classes, each a single isometry class. The published five-point distance matrices in Example 14 exactly match the claim: nonisometric incident-distance profiles and identical verbose barcodes. The lower-bound classification is analytic, not extrapolation from enumeration.
